baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verbal noun at word 1 is followed by a source phrase naming the Lord at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The caused-delivery branch of ن ز ل makes the clause a directed transfer, while ربوبية makes its source an owning and governing agent rather than an impersonal height.

activation_trace.role: Caused lowering and delivery supply the directed transfer at the model's core.
Ownership and sovereignty identify the transfer's deliberate governing source.

changed_reading.before: A generic object or statement has descended from above.
changed_reading.after: This is an intentionally delivered disclosure whose provenance is the sovereign Lord of every world.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1, 3, and 4 join تنزيل, Lordship, and the worlds in one source construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The placement branch of ن ز ل combines with gradual nurture and completion in ر ب ب and the distinguishing-sign branch of ع ل م: the descent is an apt emplacement that forms and marks its recipient worlds.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station supplies deliberate emplacement rather than bare motion.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the source's placement formative.
A distinguishing mark lets the placed disclosure function as an orienting sign across worlds.

changed_reading.before: The clause reports only the downward arrival of revelation.
changed_reading.after: The clause also presents revelation as a formative sign deliberately put into its fitting station by the one who nurtures the worlds.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تنزيل at word 1 carries a branch of prepared reception, and the source is رب at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The guest-provision branch of ن ز ل lets the delivered thing be heard as something prepared for arrivals; Lordly ownership supplies the host-like agency that issues it toward the worlds.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arriving guest supplies a hospitality model for the descent.
The owner and master supplies the agent who prepares and sends that reception.

changed_reading.before: The descent is only transmission of content.
changed_reading.after: The descent may also be a prepared provision from the Lord, offered to the worlds as recipients arriving under his care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Celestial locations, a noble recitation, a written and protected repository, and regulated contact turn the focus placement model into controlled passage through stations of custody, ending in an exact delivered position.

activation_trace.role: Proper emplacement supplies the focus-side endpoint of an ordered transfer.
Falling and becoming fixed supply definite landing positions rather than undifferentiated space.
The rising celestial body makes those fixed positions part of an ordered celestial frame.
Recitation identifies the transferred item as communicative disclosure.
Honor and generosity give the disclosed item protected value within the transfer.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a stable textual station.
Protective concealment supplies custody before disclosure reaches recipients.
Tactile contact makes access to the protected transfer concrete and gated.
Removal of impurity supplies the qualification governing that access.

structural_cues: 56:75-80 advances from located celestial signs to recitation, repository, access condition, and finally source-attributed descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed locations, valued recitation, protected writing, touch, and purification; I infer an arrow from that sequence to successive custody stations in تنزيل. A live alternative is that these are independent authority predicates and do not describe a transmission route.

changed_reading.before: تنزيل denotes a simple downward delivery.
changed_reading.after: تنزيل denotes a controlled transfer whose provenance is preserved through ordered stations until it is placed for qualified reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The noble recitation is immediately treated as renewing discourse, then met with oil-like accommodation and denial; رزق makes the hospitality branch of تنزيل function as allotted sustenance that its beneficiaries can perversely convert into rejection.

activation_trace.role: Prepared guest provision supplies the focus model that the following reception language sharpens.
Recitation supplies the orally received form of the provision.
Nobility and generosity characterize the received discourse as a gift.
Speech that renews itself keeps the descended provision active in address.
Pliant accommodation supplies the mechanism for smoothing the active discourse into compromise.
An allotted gift recasts reception of the descent as receipt of one's assigned sustenance.
Imputing falsehood supplies the beneficiary's inversion of the received gift.

structural_cues: 56:77 names the item, 56:80 attributes its delivery, and 56:81-82 stage the hearers' handling of it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies noble recitation, renewing speech, accommodation, allotted provision, and falsification; I infer that provision characterizes the descended discourse and that denial is a misuse of reception. Alternatively, رزق may name the hearers' worldly share or gratitude rather than revelation itself.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies the source of a message.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies a generous, sustaining delivery whose recipients can deform hospitality into compromise and make their very share an act of denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The deathbed challenge tests the source claim in 56:80: an unseen but nearer governing agency controls a passage that reaches its bodily limit while observers cannot reverse it, so Lordly provenance becomes active control over one-way transfers.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery supplies the focus-side instance of directed transfer.
Sovereign ownership supplies the agency whose control is tested by the following challenge.
Reaching an endpoint supplies the irreversible passage's terminal moment.
The conduit of breath and food gives that terminal moment a bodily threshold.
Directed looking supplies human witness without control.
Nearness supplies the governing agency's immediate presence at the threshold.
Physical sight supplies the denied mode by which observers try to locate that nearer agency.
Subjection and ownership frame the claim that humans might escape the governing relation.
Restoration to a former state supplies the demanded reversal humans cannot perform.
Making a claim real by action turns reversal into the proposed proof of autonomy.

structural_cues: 56:83-87 forms one conditional challenge: endpoint, witness, unseen nearness, claimed non-subjection, and demanded return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reached threshold, seeing without sight, greater nearness, subjection, and a failed demand to restore; I infer that this asymmetry exemplifies the active Lordship named as revelation's source. The alternative is that the death scene proves sovereignty generally without specifying how تنزيل operates.

changed_reading.before: From the Lord of the worlds is a static provenance label.
changed_reading.after: From the Lord of the worlds is a control claim: the sender of disclosure also governs passages humans can witness but neither see through nor reverse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outcome sequence offers rest, garden, blessing, and safety to some, then repeats ن ز ل for a hostile provision of hot fluid to others. This exact recurrence makes the focus descent a prior offered hospitality whose reception can culminate in welcome or a punitive parody of welcome.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arrival supplies the hospitality potential in the focus descent.
Rest and relief supply the benign mode of final reception.
A tree-sheltered garden supplies the welcoming place of reception.
Blessed good condition supplies the quality of that welcome.
Safety from harm supplies a second benign reception formula.
The repeated prepared provision turns hospitality into an explicit but hostile lodging image.
Hot water supplies the punitive contents of the inverted provision.
Intensely blazing fire supplies the destination that completes the hostile reception.

structural_cues: 56:88-94 sorts arrivals into contrasting receptions, and 56:80 and 56:93 share both the ن ز ل root and a following source phrase with من.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting receptions and an exact ن ز ل recurrence; I infer that the later hostile provision retrospectively activates hospitality in تنزيل and links offered disclosure to final reception. Alternatively, the later نزل may name punishment without intentionally recoloring 56:80.

changed_reading.before: The verse makes a formal statement about revelation's source.
changed_reading.after: The verse also offers a Lordly provision in advance: acceptance aligns with welcome, while rejection ends in a grim reversal of the same hospitality lexeme.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement from reality-matched certainty to glorifying the named Lord makes the source statement performative: recognizing where the descent comes from issues in verbal purification and magnification of that source.

activation_trace.role: Lordly sovereignty supplies the source whose recognition calls for response.
A distinguishing sign lets the worlds become the broad field in which source recognition occurs.
Reality-matched truth supplies objective confirmation of the source claim.
Stable knowledge without doubt supplies the hearer's settled recognition.
Declaring freedom from defect supplies the verbal act generated by recognition.
The name as indication supplies the uttered pointer back to the source.
The alternative mapped image of a visible identifying mark reinforces the name's sign function.
The repeated Lord-title closes the loop back to the source named in the focus.
Greatness and power supply the magnitude confessed in the response.

structural_cues: 56:95 certifies this as certain truth, and 56:96 immediately converts certification into a command addressed to the focus verse's رب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth, certainty, glorification, name, repeated Lordship, and greatness; I infer a causal arrow from recognizing the descent's provenance to praising its source. A live alternative is that the final command closes the whole surah and is not specifically generated by 56:80.

changed_reading.before: From the Lord of the worlds merely identifies origin.
changed_reading.after: The origin claim initiates a response circuit: certain recognition of the descent culminates in naming, purifying, and magnifying its Lordly source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's secondary ر ب و mapping for focus ر ب ب and cross-domain vegetation images at 56:89. It remains anchored in تنزيل, رب, and العالمين and is contextually supported by the garden cluster, but downstream prose should present it only as a growth analogy, not as the lexical replacement for Lordship or direct delivery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تنزيل at word 1 is sourced from رب at word 3 toward the sign-bearing العالمين at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Putting something in its fitting station supplies an installment placed where growth can occur.
Feeding and organic growth supply the exploratory cultivation function of the Lordly source.
A distinguishing mark lets cultivated worlds emerge as increasingly legible sign-domains.
A fragrant plant and its leaves supply concrete vegetal material for the cultivation analogy.
Intertwining, surging vegetation supplies the developed environment produced by cultivation.
Flourishing good condition supplies the cultivation's beneficial outcome.

changed_reading.before: A message is delivered to already constituted worlds.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the descent is a cultivative installment by which the Lord feeds, marks, and matures worlds into flourishing sign-bearing domains.

strongest_changes: The star-location, guarded-book, and qualified-touch sequence turns simple descent into controlled emplacement through ordered custody.
Provision language and the exact ن ز ل recurrence at 56:93 expose a hospitality axis that can end in welcome or punitive reversal.
The death challenge and closing certainty-praise sequence make Lordly provenance an active control claim that demands response.
summary.what_was_special: The exact ن ز ل recurrence after the focus and the packet's split ر ب ب to ر ب و inventory opened hospitality and cultivation models without displacing direct delivery.
remaining_uncertainties: The celestial locations may certify revelation's authority without depicting stages of transmission.
رزق may concern the hearers' worldly share or gratitude rather than naming revelation as sustenance.
The later نزل may be local punishment language rather than a deliberate retrospective activation of تنزيل.
The cultivation outlier depends on a secondary mapped root and should remain explicitly analogical.
